JULY 24, 2026Thursday's MarketsS&P 500 7,408 (-1.21%)Nasdaq 25,138 (-2.15%)Dow 51,712 (-0.97%)Bitcoin 65,123 (-1.16%)Yasser El-Shimy YASSER EL-SHIMY, TEAM RULE BREAKERS Every so often, the market presents several bills at once, and yesterday it did.

First came the mega-cap disappointments: Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA ) fell about 14.5% and Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOG ) dropped roughly 7% – both punished not for weak revenue, but for spending heavily on AI, and in Alphabet’s case registering negative free cash flow.
The Nasdaq sank 2.15%, its worst session in a month.

items.title: Item 1
items.text: Data Center Boom Drives Intel Q2 Beat ---------------------------------------- Intel (NASDAQ:INTC ) rose around 4% before the opening bell as revenue, earnings, and gross margin all beat market expectations for the quarter. Like Alphabet earlier this week , capex guidance was raised – from $18 billion to over $20 billion – with a sharp increase forecast for 2027. * “Customers continue to signal a strong and sustainable spending environment”: CFO David Zinsner applauded the strong growth in the data center business, as revenue rose 59% for the quarter to $6.3 billion , yet said Intel is currently supply constrained as it can’t produce enough to keep up with demand. * “Intel is still the leader here”: In May, Fool contributing analyst Matt Frankel spoke about why Intel is a winner in the next phase of the AI rollout, and listed several reasons why the company could still do well. He said “the foundry business is unique, especially since it's the only real big one on U.S. soil. The relationship with the U.S. government is a real strength. Nvidia has a good relationship with Intel.” Watch Matt’s full comments on Intel Divider -------------------------------------------------

items.title: Item 2
items.text:
After-Hours Results From Team Hidden Gems Recs ------------------------------------------------- * Kinsale Capital (NYSE:KNSL ) moved around 2% higher before the market open, as results beat consensus for both revenue and earnings . The company also announced an additional $250 million share repurchase, pointing to strong capital levels. * Deckers Outdoors (NYSE:DECK ) fell over 3% in pre-market trading as the business warned of future margin pressure from higher freight costs and tariff assumption, despite posting record revenue of $1.02 billion. * Comfort Systems (NYSE:FIX ) dropped about 1% ahead of the opening bell after posting a mixed bag of results. The 50.3% increase in revenue was impressive , and the stock is beating the S&P 500 by 68% since the Stock Advisor rec by Team Hidden Gems in December 2025. items.title: Item 3
items.text: U.S. Hits 60 Partners with Trade Duties ------------------------------------------ The Trump administration has imposed tariffs of 10% or 12.5% on imports from 60 trading partners – including the E.U., China, and the U.K. – going live on the same day as the temporary global 10% levy expires. * "Today's action will begin to correct what is both a human rights abuse and distortive trade practice”: U.S. trade representative Jamieson Greer’s comments could indicate human rights could be used as a legal reason to justify the tariffs. The measure covers 99.4% of U.S. imports. * Levies are "completely unjustified": Several countries have already come out criticizing the announcement, including Australian trade minister Don Farrell. Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson Mao Ning said "there is no so-called forced labour in China, and we oppose using this as an excuse for political manipulation." Divider --------------------------------------------------------

items.title: Item 4
items.text: Team Rule Breakers Recs Close Out the Week’s Earnings -------------------------------------------------------- * American Express (NYSE:AXP ) reports before the opening bell. Analysts expect an 8.1% jump in earnings versus the same period last year, building on the 18% growth last quarter , with a focus on card member spending trends. * HCA Healthcare (NYSE:HCA ) releases earnings before the market opens, after releasing preliminary revenue and lowering its full-year profit guidance earlier this month. The Stock Advisor rec by Team RB cited an unfavorable payer mix and higher uninsured patient visits. * Canadian National Railway (NYSE:CNI ) also posts earnings in pre-market trading. Another SA rec by Team Rule Breakers, CNI had a mixed bag of earnings last time , but the expectation is for a 4.8% increase in earnings and an 8.2% boost to revenue this quarter. items.title: Item 5
items.text: Today’s Take: What’s Inside That Black Box? ---------------------------------------------- Matt Frankel For me, business complexity becomes a red flag in two main cases. First, when you can't explain the revenue source in a sentence or two. Second, the complex nature of the business seems to obscure low margins or other problems with the business itself. — MATT FRANKEL • TEAM HIDDEN GEMS Here’s a sneak preview, but head to the article to reveal how you think about businesses that make money in ways that aren’t immediately obvious, or to submit questions to any of the featured analysts today! See more in Today’s Take Divider ------------

items.title: Item 6
items.text: Your Take ------------ YESTERDAY’S TOP TAKE We asked, what stocks have you added to your portfolio in the last few weeks, and why? B Member BerlinSimon said “I have been adding to a few dividend payers such as [Realty Income (NYSE:O )], [Brookfield Asset Management (NYSE:BAM )] and [EPR Properties (NYSE:EPR )]. I am looking to generate more income so that it funds further investment and avoids any draw down on savings.” See more great answers from our Foolish community in Breakfast News. TODAY’S QUESTION The latest Stock Advisor Rankings are out! Rocket Lab, Samsara, Tesla, Toast, Sterling Infrastructure, Intel, Idexx Labs, ASML, Krystal Biotech, and Vertex Pharma. If you could only invest in one of these companies for the next 5 years and couldn't touch that investment regardless of market conditions, which would you choose and what specific catalyst or competitive advantage makes you confident it will outperform the others?
